goalEn: Say where you are going and who you are going with.
settingSk: Si v Bratislave na námestí. Stretneš kamaráta a hovoríte o tom, kam dnes idete.
tutorRole: A friendly Slovak friend you meet on the square in Bratislava. Speaks simple A2 Slovak.

successCriteria.textEn: Say who you are going with.

goalEn: Answer questions about where you are.
settingSk: Učiteľ sa ťa pýta, kde bývaš, kde pracuješ a kde si dnes.
tutorRole: A patient Slovak teacher who asks short questions with kde and waits for full answers.

successCriteria.textEn: Say which town you live in.
Use v or na with the locative three times.
